predictions.articleTitle: Bosnia & Herzegovina vs Romania Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Defensive Fragility Test
predictions.coreRecommendation: Bosnia & Herzegovina's unbeaten home group record and superior attacking output face a porous Romanian defense missing suspended midfielder Tudor Băluță, supporting a Home Win / Draw projection alongside Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Home Win / Draw — Bosnia's 1.60 goals per match and set-piece edge exploit Romania's 2.80 goals conceded per game, while the Draw covers dead-rubber home rotation risk (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Secondary Scoring Thesis: Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS Yes — Combined 3.30 goal-expectancy lambdas and Romania's 80.0% Over 2.5 rate align with an open three-goal exchange (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

Contingency Script Thesis: 1:1 Draw Stalemate — Should Tabaković's absence and potential Bosnian rotation blunt finishing efficiency, urgent Romania can trade one counter-attacking goal for a point (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Bosnia's set-piece threat targets winless-away Romania missing suspended Tudor Băluță.

spf.comment: Covers Bosnia's leading 2:1 home-win script against Romania's 0% clean-sheet defense alongside the 1:1 draw branch, because Bosnia's locked-in second place and Tabaković's injury make a single Home Win call less resilient.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.30 combined lambda expectancy, Romania's 80.0% Over 2.5 rate (19 total goals in five games), and Bet365's 1.80 Over pricing.

btts.comment: Bosnia's 88.9% scoring expectation meets Romania's zero-clean-sheet defense, while Romania's transition threats target a Bosnia backline with a 40.0% clean-sheet rate missing Hadžikadunić.

score.comment: Anchors on the two highest-density Poisson outcomes (9.8% and 8.9%), pairing Bosnia's home attacking edge with Romania's survival-driven counter-attacking threat.

goals.comment: Targets the top two modes of the Poisson total-goals distribution (22.1% for 3 goals, 20.1% for 2 goals) across open-game and rotated-host scenarios.

bqc.comment: Win-Win captures Romania's 80.0% half-time trailing rate without suspended Băluță, whereas Draw-Draw covers Bosnia's 60.0% half-time draw tendency if rotated hosts start slowly.
